title: Increase MATRIX_LR for faster transformer convergence
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 to accelerate Muon optimizer convergence on transformer matrices within fixed 5-minute budget
reflection: The 1.5x increase in MATRIX_LR resulted in val_bpb 0.996471, a ~0.000127 improvement over baseline 0.996598. This validates the hypothesis that the Muon learning rate for matrix parameters was slightly conservative for the time-constrained training window. The model trained 922 steps with stable convergence and no OOM, confirming that the optimization velocity is the right lever to turn in a fixed time budget—not schedule tuning (Round 0) or capacity addition (Round 1).
